summary: Quoin Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to announce that the FDA conditionally approved QYLEKI as the proposed brand name for its investigational product QRX003, for Netherton Syndrome. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. No financial terms, merger consideration, premium, stake, or timeline are provided. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure; it does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special-situation event.
